visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a completed tiramisu mousse in a stem glass. A hand sprinkles fine dark cocoa powder over the top, which is already garnished with a small piece of green parsley. (2) A male chef with short black hair, wearing a white professional chef's coat with red and black embroidery on the collar and chest, stands in a studio setting with a white brick background. He speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with both hands. (3) A sequence of close-up top-down shots shows ingredients being prepared. Coffee powder is poured from a small glass bowl into a larger glass bowl containing white milk. A metal whisk is used to stir the mixture. (4) The milk and coffee mixture is poured into a red cooking pan on an induction stove. A large piece of dark chocolate is added and stirred with a whisk as it melts into the liquid. (5) Several large white marshmallows are dropped into the steaming brown liquid in the red pan. The chef continues to whisk vigorously as the marshmallows melt and create a frothy, bubbly texture. (6) The mixture is poured through a fine metal sieve into a glass. After a jump cut, the set mousse is dusted again with cocoa powder using a sifter. (7) A sprig of parsley is placed onto the center of the dark cocoa surface. The camera showcases the dessert in both a glass and a rectangular glass container, with a spoon lifting a portion to show the texture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano track begins, establishing a warm and upbeat atmosphere. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity, introducing the tiramisu mousse recipe. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition as the speaker emphasizes the '3-2-1' steps. (3) The rhythmic clinking of glass and the soft rustle of powder pouring can be heard over the continuous music as the chef describes adding coffee to milk. (4) A splashing sound occurs as the liquid enters the pan, followed by the metallic whisking sound against the pan's surface. (5) Thudding sounds of soft marshmallows hitting liquid are audible, followed by a rapid, frothy whisking sound as the mixture emulsifies. (6) A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect highlights the final ingredient proportions shown on screen. The speaker's tone remains consistently encouraging and professional throughout the demonstration. (7) The audio concludes with a final summary of the chilling process, with the BGM fading out smoothly at the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredients -> Step-by-step Process -> Final Result -> Professional Tip
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers an simplified, 'fail-proof' method for making Tiramisu Marshmallow Mousse using only four main ingredients. By highlighting the '3-2-1' ratio and the built-in gelatin properties of marshmallows, the chef removes the complexity typically associated with mousse-making, making the dessert accessible to home cooks and party hosts.
